tools.name: memory_write
tools.description: Append one line to MEMORY.md, your only persistent memory. It is shown in full at the top of every context.

summary.zh: 往 MEMORY.md 末尾追加一行。

tools.name: end_turn
tools.description: End this turn: nothing more you want to say or do right now. New events will wake you again. This is the normal way to finish a turn.

summary.zh: 结束这一轮,等新事件再醒。
summary.en: Ends the turn until a new event arrives.

form.zh: 一份 MEMORY.md,整份进系统前缀;附件存在 blobs/ 下。
form.en: One MEMORY.md, all of it in the system prefix; attachments go under blobs/.
